MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Adhesive-lined heat shrink tubing complements my spade connectors by helping insulate and seal wiring repairs, giving it a clear use alongside supplies I already bought.",
    "The small quick-setting Loctite epoxy fits my occasional repair needs, much like my tape and vinyl cement, without requiring a specialized project."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The battery lugs and washers require particular cable, stud, or fastener sizes that my purchases do not establish I need.",
    "The other tubing assortments overlap with the adhesive-lined kit I would choose; more pieces or colors do not create another need.",
    "Layout fluid, replacement casters, test leads, and steel-reinforced epoxy each imply a particular task that I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying wire connectors seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest many electrical supplies, although sealing connections, working on heavy battery cables, and troubleshooting circuits are different needs.",
    "My handtruck and adhesive purchases seem to have been stretched into assumptions about cart building and specialized repairs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I need a clear practical use before choosing a repair supply; related tools alone do not establish a current project or compatible dimensions.",
    "A useful addition to supplies I own matters more than several alternatives that serve the same purpose.",
    "My most recent purchase was a duct clamp, so older wiring and handtruck purchases are limited evidence of what I need now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical repair interests, but often assumed specific projects or repeated needs that my purchases do not establish."
}
